name: Canada

flag.description: A red vertical band at each end, each a quarter of the width, with a white square in the centre holding a red stylised 11-point maple leaf.
flag.symbolism: Red and white were proclaimed Canada's official colours in 1921, and the maple leaf has long been a national emblem.

hook: Canada is red-white-red standing up with one 11-point maple leaf on a wide white square; Peru has no leaf and three equal bands.
trivia: The flag was first raised on 15 February 1965, now marked as National Flag of Canada Day.
The stylised maple leaf has 11 points, although real maple leaves usually have more.
Canada has the longest coastline of any country in the world.
